positions.title: Software Engineer Resident
positions.description:
• Provide code support, debugging, and code review for 100+ junior developers in building multiple front-end applications and four full-stack (MERN) applications.

• Provide instruction in conceptualizing and implementing development technologies (React, Node.js), SQL and noSQL databases, deployment and CS fundamentals.

• Evaluate student-written code to provide feedback for code fluency, readability, reusability and overall best practices.

• Conduct mock interviews and whiteboarding sessions to prepare engineers for technical interviews and develop algorithmic problem solving.

positions.title: Clinical Director of Rehabilitation - Physical Therapist
positions.locationName: 15632 Bear Valley Rd Suite 108, Victorville, CA 92395
positions.description:
• Developed and established operational, clinical, and marketing strategy from the ground up resulting in over two hundred active patients per therapist.

• Created the Wave PT Rehabilitation Chronic Pain Treatment Framework successfully treating over 600 chronic pain patients with significant history of failed past medical interventions per year.

• Established referral chain amongst fifteen different physician providers in the High Desert for collaborative care.

• Managed high volume caseload of patients (17-22/ day) from evaluation, treatment to discharge. Successfully treated chronic pain patients with significant history of failed medical interventions including pain medications and prior therapy.

• Directly managed and supervised support staff including PTA, office manager, medical biller, and office workers.

• Supervised clinical instruction and education of Physical Therapist students, Physical Therapist Assistants, and prospective PT Students.
